benchmark: passive buy-and-hold: open(first OOS bar) -> close(last OOS bar), no costs (favours the benchmark)

cost_model.status: PLACEHOLDER numbers (config/settings.yaml): not calibrated to any broker; NOT tuned here

data_identity: each run manifest carries provider, symbol, data_version, raw/normalized hashes, verified coverage, research window
determinism: every primary run is repeated (save=False) and must reproduce fold params, metrics and equity exactly

fold_design.boundary: train=[s,s+train) test=[s+train,s+train+test); history before a window is warm-up only
fold_design.lockbox: final lockbox_bars excluded from folds and engine calls; never evaluated in this batch
fold_design.min_bars: train+test+lockbox must fit, else ValueError (no fold is invented)
fold_design.oos: evaluation only; parameters of a fold are never changed after its OOS is seen
fold_design.train_selection: max train net_return over the existing grid; ties -> grid order (existing contract)
fold_design.warmup: strategies see bars before trade_start for indicators; signals start at trade_start

kr_coverage: KR requests outside 2020-01-02..2025-12-30 are rejected (DataRejected); no Yahoo/Naver fallback

market_scopes.common_period: SECONDARY: intersection of verified coverages; reported separately, never mixed
market_scopes.market_specific: PRIMARY: each market's own verified coverage (start_bar=0)

multiple_testing: UNKNOWN: no correction; 3 strategies x 3 markets are tested once each
purpose: Walk-Forward development/OOS research on verified real data; Lockbox NOT opened
strategy_state: strategy.reset() before every engine run (existing contract)

thresholds.lockbox_requires: PASS and stitched OOS net return > passive buy-and-hold return over the same OOS windows
